overview.about: The Fortinet Founders Cup honours the 13 women who founded the LPGA in 1950, celebrating the tour's history and its charitable roots. It brings a strong field together for a prestigious title tied to the origins of women's professional golf.
overview.nextEvent: The next Fortinet Founders Cup pays tribute to the LPGA's founders while pitting the modern tour's best against each other. Charity and heritage are woven through the week alongside the competition.
